code_systems.iso639_1: ISO 639-1 — two-letter codes, used by `language`/`quote_language` fields and report file names.
code_systems.iso639_2b: ISO 639-2/B — three-letter bibliographic codes, used by `language_iso639_2b` and published as repository language metadata.

_about.note: Language-specific UI strings live in en.json / el.json. This file is language-neutral data, so it exists once.
_about.purpose: Machine-readable language registry for the dataset (COAR multilingual compliance).
_about.ui: Only two languages are this dataset's own: en and el — every human-readable field is written in both. de appears solely because two quoted sources are written in German; it is not a dataset language and has no UI strings.
